title: Higher-order colossally abundant numbers
summary: Colossally abundant numbers have large sums of divisors relative to their size. They also admit a geometric description using supporting lines of a planar convex hull. Starting from this description, we change coordinates to obtain nested subsets of these numbers, which we call colossally abundant numbers of higher order. Their definition does not depend on the Riemann hypothesis. We give conditions under which Robin's inequality holds on any one of these subsets if and only if the Riemann hypothesis is true.
